spec_match.rationale: Probes the exact iamf.PPP.AAA.<codec> grammar from IAMF v1.0 §6.3 (verified against the spec text and Chromium's ParseIamfCodecId in media/base/audio_codecs.cc), including three deliberately invalid strings the grammar requires every browser to reject.

interactive.rationale: Run-all button executes canPlayType, MediaSource.isTypeSupported, and mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo per row and paints each API's raw returned value into the table; nothing is precomputed.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index promises exact codec strings with each API's answer shown separately; the page delivers exactly that, muxed A/V string included.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers all four substream codecs, Base profile, a muxed avc1+iamf string, three grammar-invalid strings, missing-API branches, and distinguishes decodingInfo's resolve-supported-false vs TypeError-reject shapes (both observed in browser).

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5113656292540416, IAMF §6.3 codecs parameter anchor, and the Media Capabilities spec.

conformance.rationale: The new feature suite mirrors these exact contracts: 4 positive per-codec assertions plus canPlayType and decodingInfo (failing honestly here) and 3 negative grammar assertions that pass in any browser.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified via headless Chromium 141 CDP (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this sandbox): autorun executed all 9 rows on desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740, DOM greps confirmed real values ('"" (no)', false, supported:false, TypeError on the muxed row), zero console errors and only the known environmental fonts stylesheet failure. The supported path could not be exercised because this Chromium has no IAMF decoder — only the honest-negative branch is browser-proven.

telemetry_health.rationale: Reports iamf-matrix-supported (with invalid-accepted count) on the supported branch and iamf-matrix-unsupported-fallback separately; a fallback run is never reported as a pass.

design_system.rationale: Only CSS variables; button override keeps global colors; verdict text is black/rose (both AA on white) with the emerald reserved for a >=3:1 check glyph after the initial emerald-text version measured 4.01:1 and was fixed.

accessibility.rationale: Native table with caption and th scope on both axes, native button, aria-live polite status output, focus-visible outlines, and the horizontal scroller is keyboard-focusable with an aria-label; screen-reader tree not inspected (no MCP here) — noted as open question.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP device-metrics runs at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x800: scrollWidth equalled innerWidth on both (no horizontal overflow) after wrapping pre/banner tokens; the wide matrix scrolls inside its own overflow-x container; 44px tap targets.

openQuestions.title: Verify the supported path on an IAMF-enabled Chrome 152 build
openQuestions.detail: Run the matrix on Chrome 152+ compiled with media_use_iamf_tools and launched with --enable-features=IamfAudioDecoding: valid rows should flip to non-empty canPlayType (record whether it answers 'maybe' or 'probably'), isTypeSupported true, and decodingInfo supported:true, while the three invalid rows must stay rejected.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree once chrome-devtools-mcp is available
openQuestions.detail: Confirm the per-row verdict spans and the focusable overflow scroller (role=group with aria-label) read sensibly in the accessibility tree, and that the run-status live region announces the summary after Run all probes.

guidanceConsulted.query: media playback progress loading error retry states accessible live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native semantic elements (tables with caption/th scope, buttons) and give visual state changes aria-live text equivalents.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Results table uses caption + th scope=col/row; run status is an aria-live polite output; all controls are native elements.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive results table readout mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide content must scroll inside its own overflow container instead of stretching the page; verify no unintended horizontal overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Matrix table (min-width 52rem) lives in a focusable overflow-x:auto scroller; pre/banner tokens wrap with overflow-wrap:anywhere; CDP metrics show scrollWidth==innerWidth at 360px and 1280px.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: cdp-check METRICS overflow:false at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800

summary: Matrix probes the exact §6.3 grammar through three capability APIs with honest raw answers. Headless Chromium 141 CDP verified both viewport classes, the honest-unsupported messaging, the invalid-string rejections, and the muxed-string TypeError; the positive IAMF path awaits a decoder-enabled Chrome 152 build.
